question: The couple who won Padma Bhushan in 2009 for Bharatanatyam is _________

options.text: K.V. Sampath Kumar and Vidushi K.S. Jayalakshmi
Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan

solution:
The correct answer is __**Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The couple who won **Padma Bhushan in 2009** for **Bharatanatyam** is** Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan **and **Shanta Dhananjayan.**
 
• They are renowned Bharatanatyam dancers from **Tamil Nadu, India.**
 
• They have also received numerous other** awards and recognitions **for their contributions to the art form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahaboob Subhani and Kaleeshabi Mahboob** are renowned** Kuchipudi dancers** from Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• **K.V. Sampath Kumar and Vidushi K.S. Jayalakshmi** are** Carnatic musicians **from Karnataka, India.
 
• **Krishna Ella and Suchitra Ella **are** scientists and entrepreneurs **who founded the biotechnology company Bharat Biotech.
